tagline.en: An embodied manipulation policy from OpenDriveLab that predicts action sequences from multi-camera views.
tagline.zh: OpenDriveLab 推出的具身操作策略,从多相机画面预测动作序列。

en: RISE is a vision-based robot manipulation policy from OpenDriveLab. It reads camera observations and predicts a sequence of future actions, following a Pi0.5-style action architecture with the project's official deployment preprocessing.

In WorldFoundry the policy runs in-process: three-camera image mapping, input normalization, the action model, and a 50x14 action output all execute through the pipeline. The public asset repository ships the dynamics model and sample data rather than a trained action-policy checkpoint, so you supply compatible trained action weights and their task normalization statistics to run rollouts.
zh: RISE 是 OpenDriveLab 推出的基于视觉的机器人操作策略。它读取相机观测,预测一段未来动作序列,采用 Pi0.5 风格的动作架构,并使用项目官方的部署预处理。
在 WorldFoundry 中,该策略在进程内运行:三相机图像映射、输入归一化、动作模型,以及 50x14 的动作输出都通过 pipeline 执行。公开的资源仓库提供的是动力学模型与示例数据,而非训练好的动作策略 checkpoint,因此你需要自备兼容的训练动作权重及其任务归一化统计量来跑 rollout。

whenToUse.en: When you want an OpenDriveLab manipulation policy with a Pi0.5-style action head and already have (or will train) compatible action weights for your task.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用 OpenDriveLab 的操作策略、采用 Pi0.5 风格动作头,并且已有(或将训练)针对任务的兼容动作权重时。

notFor.en: Not ready to run out of the box: the public release provides code and a dynamics model but no trained action-policy checkpoint, which you must supply along with its normalization statistics.
notFor.zh: 它不能开箱即用:公开发布提供的是代码与动力学模型,但没有训练好的动作策略 checkpoint,需要你自备并附上其归一化统计量。

en: Vision-based manipulation policy with a Pi0.5-style action architecture
Three-camera input mapping and official deployment preprocessing
Predicts a 50x14 action sequence per rollout
zh: 采用 Pi0.5 风格动作架构的视觉操作策略
三相机输入映射与官方部署预处理
每次 rollout 预测 50x14 的动作序列
动作策略权重需用户自备
